rules.title: Review pending snapshots
rules.text: Review pending snapshots with cargo insta review, or inspect the diff, before accepting them.

rules.title: Never hand-edit snapshots
rules.text: Never edit snapshot files or inline snapshot bodies by hand. Regenerate them with a test run and review the diff.

rules.title: Fail on mismatch in CI
rules.text: Run cargo insta test --check in CI so mismatches fail instead of writing files.

rules.title: Check for leftovers
rules.text: After a forced-update run, look for leftover .pending-snap files when inline snapshots are involved.

rules.title: Redact unstable values
rules.text: Redact nondeterministic values such as timestamps and ids before snapshotting.

rules.title: Explicit cases
rules.text: Write explicit snapshots per scenario instead of looping over cases that share one snapshot.

rules.title: Clean unreferenced
rules.text: Remove unreferenced snapshots after deleting tests, for example with --unreferenced=delete.
